title: AGY PPT source inventory (Phase 12)
description: Layer B (deterministic) contract for the source inventory sidecar artifact. AGY (Layer A) decides what the source units are, their labels, and their priority; this schema only defines the shape a Python validator can check structurally. It never stores the confidential source text itself -- only a minimal locator and an optional caller-supplied digest of it. This is additive to, and never referenced from, the frozen project_state.schema.json.

enabled.description: source_grounding.enabled. false (or a missing file) means this project does not use source grounding at all; no traceability/coverage/QA artifact is required.

sources.description: The documents/materials the deck is grounded in.

units.description: Stable source units carved out of the sources above.

source_id.description: Stable, human-debuggable, caller-supplied id. Never an absolute local path and never a random-UUID-only identity.

source_type.description: e.g. 'pdf', 'docx', 'markdown', 'text', 'transcript', 'generic'. Open vocabulary; AGY supplies it.

source_digest.description: Optional sha256 hex digest for change detection. Never the source text itself.

metadata.description: Minimal necessary metadata only. Credential-shaped keys are rejected by the validator.

unit_id.description: Deterministic stable id derived from (source_id, locator), e.g. 'su:src_contract:1a2b3c4d'. Resume-safe: recomputing it from the same source_id+locator always yields the same value.

unit_type.description: e.g. 'clause', 'paragraph', 'section', 'figure', 'generic'. Open vocabulary; AGY supplies it.

locator.description: Extensible source-locator contract. Never an OS absolute file path; a locator describes a position *within* a source document, identified by source_id.
